77% of remote jobs hide pay. But that's not a warning—it's a negotiation signal. Here's the data from Loker Dollar.

Out of 4,441 active remote listings, only 1,000 (23%) disclose compensation. The remaining 3,441 (77%) keep it private. This is a contrarian take: hidden pay doesn't mean low wages—many firms expect you to negotiate.

Key numbers:
• 2,753 listings (62%) are open to worldwide applicants—your ticket to USD roles.
• 1,427 engineering roles are open, with 276 posted this week.
• Top skills (from 4,282 listings): Communication (39%), AI (12%), Leadership (10%).
• 1,560 companies are hiring, including Neo Financial ($5/hr), TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, Jobgether—only Neo discloses pay.

Don't let hidden pay stop you. Filter for 'worldwide remote' on the Loker Dollar board and apply before listings close. Start now: https://lokerdollar.com/en
